name: JSON Validator
description: Generic JSON validator. Schema is passed as input (not hardcoded). Strips prefixes, extracts from markdown, validates required fields/types/allowed values. Returns cleaned JSON or specific error messages.

inputs.description: Raw data to validate (may have prefixes, markdown wrapping, etc.)
JSON schema definition: {type, requiredFields, fieldTypes, items, allowedValues}. If omitted, only checks JSON parseability.

outputs.description: When valid: the parsed JSON data directly (pass-through). When invalid: {isValid: false, errors: [...], parsed: null}
